title: Product Developer, Sr- .Net, React JS and Kafka
jobDescription: Responsibilities include designing, developing, and supporting workflows, platform integrations, and front-end experiences for Data Plane-related solutions. What You Will Do Designs, develops, refactors, tests, and maintains full-stack applications and framework components. Builds backend services, APIs, and integration layers that support Data Plane and data governance capabilities. Develops frontend features using React and Type Script for enterprise-scale, data-intensive user experiences. Designs and supports Kafka/Confluent-based event-driven workflows and streaming integrations. Collaborates with architects and product teams on core functionality, technical designs, and implementation plans. Supports data governance use cases such as cataloging, lineage, quality, lifecycle management, consent, and masking. Contributes to platform capabilities that support Data Plane and broader enterprise data initiatives. Participates in code reviews, technical design discussions, estimation, and continuous improvement of engineering practices. Exposure to data governance, Snowflake, CDC, data pipelines, or lakehouse technologies is preferred.
